# Switch

A setting that applies at once, on or off.

- Status: implemented
- Category: input
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “switch”; HTML `<button role="switch" aria-checked>`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **track**: Fills with the accent when on.
- **thumb**: Moves to the end; the movement is instant under reduced motion.
- **label**: States the setting, not the state.

## Variants

- `default`: Label before the switch.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `checked`: The thumb's position and a filled track; never colour alone.
- `disabled`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Space, Enter | Toggles. |

## Accessibility

- Role: switch
- Name: Its label.
- Use a checkbox when the choice is submitted with a form.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <button type="button" class="nd-switch" role="switch" aria-checked="true">
    <span class="nd-switch__track" aria-hidden="true"></span> Reduce motion
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-switch" role="switch" aria-checked="false">
    <span class="nd-switch__track" aria-hidden="true"></span> Send a copy
  </button>
  <button
    type="button"
    class="nd-switch"
    role="switch"
    aria-checked="false"
    disabled
  >
    <span class="nd-switch__track" aria-hidden="true"></span> Unavailable
    setting
  </button>
</div>
```
